{{Quote|Well, I don't recall volunteering for this. And I especially don't recall wanting to go to a part of Coruscant that would scare the Red Guards white.|[[Den Dhur]] to [[Jax Pavan]]|<ref name="CNI:JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>}}
The '''Factory District'''&mdash;or as it was later known, the '''Feral City'''&mdash;was a district on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], situated in the [[Antipodes]], the exact opposite side of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]]. It was said to be the most dangerous place on the planet.<ref name="CNI:JT" />

==History==
Once a thriving industrial center many [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the development of industry on nearby [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] like [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]] and [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]] meant that work could be completed cheaper off-planet. Abandoning the facilities in the district, it became a haven for criminals and subterranean creatures. It was even rumored that there were bands of [[feral droid]]s that patrolled the Factory District.

The rather small buildings, no taller than fifty stories, fell into disrepair, as did the roadways and other fragments of the infrastructure. Because of the remoteness of the area, the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] established a secret [[Xizor's laboratory|laboratory]] where his [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] could work to perfect the technology for a [[human replica droid]]. Although Xizor hired a band of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] known as the [[Salissian/Legends|Salissians]] to eliminate the feral [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the droids proved too vicious to be controlled. The droids later [[Battle in the Factory District|attacked]] the Vigo's lab, destroying all research and personnel.

During their search for [[10-4TO]], [[Den Dhur]] and [[I-5YQ]] discovered a massive [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] leak taking place beneath the Factory District; they decided the leak had caused the droids to become murderous. While the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] and his droid escaped the area, along with former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] the reactor overloaded and detonated, creating an eighty [[Meter/Legends|meter]] crater and reducing a considerable amount of the Factory District to [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] rubble.

==Behind the scenes==
It is also referred to in the narration as "[[Wikipedia:antipodes|the Antipodes]]," the real-world term for the diametric opposite of a point on the globe. However, as its use here was capitalized, and the antipodes of the Factory District was Imperial City itself, it may be that this signifier held particular significance in this case.
